title: A commit whose KB-Work check-trailers would refuse is refused by the commit-msg hook, not only warned of
goal: kbgit.py commit-msg exits non-zero, leaving no commit, for a message whose KB-Work check-trailers refuses (a planning commit naming an item whose file it does not change), so no later step (a review's done --commit, whose evidence names the tip) builds on a commit that must be rewritten before the push. SP-vk3wf746 close: the review's parking commit named the review story in KB-Work, the hook only printed the refusal, done --commit recorded it as evidence, and the commit and the done had to be reset and run again.

run:
import subprocess, sys, tempfile, os
tool = os.path.abspath("_tools/kbgit.py")
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
def g(*a):
    return subprocess.run(["git", *a], cwd=d, capture_output=True, text=True)
g("init", "-q"); g("config", "user.email", "a@example.com"); g("config", "user.name", "n")
open(os.path.join(d, "f.txt"), "w").write("x\n"); g("add", "f.txt"); g("commit", "-q", "-m", "init", "--no-verify")
open(os.path.join(d, "f.txt"), "w").write("y\n"); g("add", "f.txt")
def hook(msg):
    mf = os.path.join(d, "MSG")
    open(mf, "w").write(msg)
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, tool, "hook", "commit-msg", mf], cwd=d, capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert "Traceback" not in p.stderr, p.stderr
    return p
bad = hook("chore(backlog): plan\n\nKB-Work: ST-zzzzzzzz\n")
ok = hook("chore: edit\n\nbody\n")
refused = bad.returncode != 0 and "refuses this commit" in bad.stderr
sys.exit(0 if refused and ok.returncode == 0 else 1)

leave the script: the refusal is only kbgit.py's exit status

exit 1, as any crash of the tool also gives
